# Support

Use GitHub Issues for reproducible SDK bugs and focused feature requests. Include the PHP version, package version or commit, a minimal example, and redacted output.

Do not include Rent Manager credentials, API tokens, tenant information, or other customer data in an issue.

- Report SDK security vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/azero/rentmanager_php/security/advisories/new).
- Contact [Rent Manager Support](https://www.rentmanager.com/support/) for account access, subscriptions, service availability, or questions about Rent Manager itself.
